messages:
Zoe: Heads-up — I'm starting bring-up for model v2.1-int4-compact in staging. planning a phased rollout with a leaseback/escrow hold for 48h. want to nail the canary gating config before we open traffic.
Sanjay: Nice. main concerns? quality regressions vs v2.0, kv-warmup sensitivity, and p95 latency tail. also cost delta.
Zoe: exactly. proposed checks: (1) hallucination rate (open-domain) delta <= +0.015 absolute, (2) MRR drop <= 0.012 relative, (3) p95 latency <= 1.2x baseline, (4) token-cost/unit <= 1.1x. if any fail -> immediate fallback.
Kevin: what about sample size / min traffic so noisy slices don't trigger false positives?
Zoe: good call. require min_samples=2000 per stage and min_unique_users=300. use sliding 30m window for short stages.
Marie: can we add a drift detector on system prompts and user prefix length? longcontext tends to blow up int4.
Zoe: yes — add seqlen-bucket check: if longctx (>1024) error rate increases by >2x, rollback.
Sanjay: how long for each stage? i'd do micro-stage then ramp: 1% for 60m, 5% for 120m, 20% for 3h, then 100% if green.
Zoe: that's the plan. also a leaseback: even after 100%, keep a 5% escrow pinned to previous variant for 48h to catch slow regressions.
Kevin: can you paste the rollout JSON we'll give to the orchestration? easier to audit.
Zoe: sure — draft below:
```json
{
  "policy": "phased",
  "stages": [
    {"pct": 1, "duration_mins": 60},
    {"pct": 5, "duration_mins": 120},
    {"pct": 20, "duration_mins": 180},
    {"pct": 100, "duration_mins": 0}
  ],
  "checks": {
    "min_samples": 2000,
    "min_unique_users": 300,
    "metrics": {
      "hallucination_abs_delta": 0.015,
      "mrr_rel_drop": 0.012,
      "p95_latency_multiplier": 1.2,
      "token_cost_multiplier": 1.1,
      "longctx_error_mul": 2.0
    }
  },
  "escrow": {"pct": 5, "duration_hours": 48}
}
```
Marie: love it. add a safeguard: if any check trips but sample < min_samples, switch to "quarantine-shadow" mode (route affected slice to shadow + alert SRE).
Zoe: added mentally — good idea. i'll update the policy before creating rollout.
Sanjay: who runs the initial shadow sweep? can we ask deploy-bot to run a 10k sample shadow with our telemetry hooks?
Zoe: @deploy-bot can you run shadow-sweep v2.1-int4-compact --samples=10000 --hooks=telemetry,kv-warmup?
deploy-bot: Scheduled shadow-sweep job: id=rs-2026-04-02-07. will post results under /canary/results/1778715300 when done.
Kevin: :thumbsup: after results land we should do a short manual review of sample failures (random 50 errors) before letting autopromote run.
Marie: agree. also tag product/safety with the run for extra eyeballs.
Zoe: will do. final ask: keep rollback fast-path enabled (auto-fallback on any metric breach + notify #incidents). i'll file the rollout config PR now.
Sanjay: Thanks — ping when PR is up and when shadow completes.
Zoe: PR: https://git.redwood/model-rollouts/pull/412 (draft). will update with quarantine-mode and sample-handling before merge.
